introBody: Add a few shows and movies you’ve watched or want to watch. We’ll use them to set up your library, Watch Next, and stats.
introTime: It takes about 2 minutes. You can change everything later.
introReassurance: You don’t need to add everything now.
watchedBody: Pick a few shows and movies you’ve already seen. You don’t need to add everything now.
watchlistTitle: What do you want to watch?
watchlistBody: Save a few shows and movies you want to come back to later.
noResultsBody: Try another title or check the spelling.
loadErrorBody: You can still search for a show or movie.
noSuggestions: Nothing to suggest right now — try searching instead.
progressBody: We marked these shows as fully watched. Change only the ones you haven’t finished.
stopBody: Choose the last episode you watched.
inclusiveNote: This episode and all earlier episodes will be marked watched.
reviewBody: Check your selections before we add them. Already-tracked titles will stay unchanged.
episodeTotalsPending: Some episode totals will be confirmed when your library is created.
clearConfirmBody: This will remove every title from this setup.
emptyReviewBody: Go back and add a few titles, or skip setup for now.
failBody: Your selections are still here. Check your connection and try again.
partialTitle: Most of your library is ready
partialBody: Some titles could not be added. You can try them again now or continue to the app.
doneBody: We added your watched titles, watchlist, and show progress.
importDoneBody: Your imported shows, movies, and progress are now in your library.
leaveBody: Your selections will be saved so you can finish later from Settings.
skipFailed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.
tooMany: You can add up to 100 shows and 100 movies at once — remove some selections first.
noAiredEpisodes: No aired episodes available yet for this show.
